app.name: CheckMyPack
app.tagline: Scan the packet. Know the truth.

landing.heroSub: Point your phone at any food packet. CheckMyPack reads the label and tells you instantly if it is legally compliant — MRP, dates, FSSAI licence and more.
landing.installHint: One tap • No Play Store needed
landing.step2d: We read it and compare with LMPC 2011 + FSSAI rules.
landing.step3d: Get PASS / VIOLATION / RETAKE with the exact rule.
landing.f1: Works offline — no internet needed to scan
landing.f5: Never falsely flags a blurry photo
landing.legal: Every verdict cites the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 and FSSAI labelling regulations.
landing.hero: Know what the label is hiding.
landing.freeNote: Free · No Play Store · Installs straight from the browser
landing.howItHelpsSub: Built for shoppers and inspectors alike.
landing.principle: The AI only reads. The rules decide.
landing.disclaimer: Advisory tool. Not a substitute for official enforcement action.
landing.feat1Body: Point your camera at the label. Results in under ten seconds.
landing.feat2Body: Every finding maps to a clause of LMPC 2011 or the FSSAI regulations.
landing.feat3Body: On-device text extraction keeps the checker usable without a network.
landing.feat4Body: Full interface translation plus spoken read-out of the verdict.
landing.flow1Body: A quality gate rejects blurred, dark or glared frames before anything is judged.
landing.flow2Body: Text is read on-device, or by a vision model when you are online.
landing.flow3Body: A deterministic rule engine — never the AI — decides pass or violation.

auth.signInSub: Your scan history and complaints stay tied to this account.

role.title: How will you use it?
role.subtitle: This tailors your home screen and available tools. You can change it later in Profile.
role.consumerBody: Scan what you buy, learn your rights, and file a complaint when a pack is non-compliant.
role.officerBody: Record field inspections, build cited case files, and track violation hotspots on a map.
role.makerBody: Pre-check artwork before a print run and catch missing declarations early.

home.offline: Offline — scans use on-device reading and sync later.
home.scanSub: Check the label against LMPC & FSSAI rules
home.guideSub: Get a readable photo first time
home.scanSubAmp: Check the label against LMPC & FSSAI rules

scan.title: Scan label
scan.sampleNote: Runs the real pipeline — quality gate, OCR and rule engine — on a bundled image.
scan.hintFrame: Fill the frame with the label
scan.hintGlare: Glare detected — tilt the pack away from the light
scan.hintBlur: Hold steady — the image is blurred
scan.permDeniedSample: Camera permission was denied. You can still upload a photo or run a sample.
scan.noCamera: No camera is available on this device. Upload a photo instead.
scan.permDeniedSettings: Camera permission was denied. Enable it in Settings, or pick a photo from your gallery.
scan.tapShutter: Tap the shutter to open the camera

processing.title: Analysing the label
processing.principle: The reader extracts. The rule engine decides.
processing.privacy: Text is read on this device. Nothing is uploaded unless you share it.

result.title: Scan result
result.expired: This product is past its expiry date.
result.detailedReportSub: Printable record with a verification QR
result.allPresent: Every declaration required by law is present and legible.
result.tapBox: Tap a box to see what was checked there.
result.noBoxes: No text regions could be pinned to the image.

retake.title: Retake needed
retake.heading: We could not read this label
retake.lightBody: Move to indirect daylight, or tilt the pack so the reflection falls away from the text.
retake.steadyBody: Brace your elbows against your body or rest the pack on a surface before tapping the shutter.
retake.frameBody: Move closer until the declaration panel occupies most of the viewfinder.

report.title: Detailed report
report.heading: Compliance verification record
report.verifyNote: Scanning this code re-opens the record so an officer can confirm it was not altered.

complaint.title: Report a violation
complaint.subtitle: Escalate a non-compliant pack
complaint.whatsappSub: Send the report as a chat
complaint.attachNote: The cited rule list and annotated photo are attached automatically.
complaint.notePlaceholder: Describe what you noticed on the pack
complaint.whereRequired: Tell us where you bought it — a shop name and locality is enough.
complaint.recordedOnline: Your report has been recorded and will be shared with enforcement officers. Keep this reference for your records.
complaint.recordedLocal: Your report has been saved on this device. Quote this reference when you call 14404 or write to the Legal Metrology office.
complaint.helplineNote: For a formal grievance, also call the National Consumer Helpline on 14404 — this app does not file with them on your behalf.

guidelines.title: Scanning guide
guidelines.subtitle: Get a readable photo first time
guidelines.doThisNote: Label square-on and filling the frame.
guidelines.notThisNote: Too far away and angled off-axis.
guidelines.lightGood: Indirect daylight, or step under a ceiling light.
guidelines.lightBad: Direct flash on glossy film — it blows out the print.
guidelines.steadyGood: Brace your elbows and tap the shutter gently.
guidelines.frameGood: The declaration panel should span most of the viewfinder.
guidelines.frameBad: Standing back so the label is a small patch of pixels.

profile.title: Profile
profile.confirmClear: Delete all stored scans? This cannot be undone.

officer.mapAria: Map of India with violation hotspots
officer.mapLocal: Violations from scans on this device
officer.noHotspots: No violations have been reported yet. Scans appear here once they are filed.
officer.registryEmpty: No brand has been reported twice yet. A brand is listed here once two or more independent violations have been filed against it.
officer.exportNote: Download the case register as a spreadsheet for filing with the state Legal Metrology office.
officer.exportLocalNote: This export covers scans stored on this device only. Sign in and connect to include reports from all users.
officer.tryDifferentSearch: Try a different search term or switch the filter.
officer.rateExplainer: Share of inspections where every mandatory declaration was present. A trend line will appear once several months of inspections have been recorded.
